title: The Five Snake Seal
summary: Five Snakemen leaders, all Dou Wang, catch Ms. Yun and attack her together. When she outfights them, they use the Five Snake Poison Breaking Seal and give up part of their lifespans to summon a Spirit Serpent from a portal. Its body is not flesh and blood, so even Yun Yun's Wind's Peak skills cannot hurt it, and it badly wounds her. Xiao Yan sees the pillar of light and turns back to help. A masked Dou Huang with a Heavenly Flame, Yao Lao in Xiao Yan's place, drives off the serpent and the Snakemen. He tells Yun Yun a kid asked him to help and to apologise, and she guesses it was Yao Yan. One Snakemen elder senses the Queen's scent on the rescuer and believes the Queen will return.
events: Five Snakemen Dou Wang attack Ms. Yun; she is too strong for them.
They use Five Snake Spirit-Gathering and the Five Snake Poison Breaking Seal, summoning a Spirit Serpent from a portal.
Yun Yun's Wind's Peak, Killer Meteorite and Wind's Peak, Dazzling Sunset cannot hurt it; she is badly wounded.
Xiao Yan and Yao Lao see the light and go back to help her.
A masked Dou Huang with a Heavenly Flame defeats the serpent; the Snakemen retreat with Snake Technique, Split.
He tells Yun Yun a kid sent him to apologise; she wonders if she will see Yao Yan again.
A Snakemen elder senses the Queen's scent and says she will return.
Xiao Yan begins swallowing the Green Lotus Core Flame with Yao Lao's guidance.
cultivation: The five Snakemen leaders are Dou Wang ('five of us Dou Wang', 271.3).

cast.name: Yun Yun
cast.quote: The strength of a Dou Huang isn't something that a Dou Wang can shake!
